text: you are aware how fucked it is right? the wheel is sharing verts with the interior, the cabin is literally a seats back piece and the trim on the back seat bench. its not even a single vert on the cabin itself
resolution: Diagnosed while building police_sedan (req_3751). Root cause found and written up in docs/handoffs/SEAT-MODEL-EDITOR-DEFECTS-0803.md: the Outliner part-range re-stamp in AppFrame.tsx:4901 bails whenever native part count differs from row count, which is a permanent latch because resyncing is the only thing that could restore parity. Consolidated with every other tool defect hit during the session into one work order.
